video.title: AI欧腐《狼王的禁忌小白兔/The Alpha's Forbidden Bunny》
video.desc:
一般不做动漫 但我看上兔子耳朵尾巴
In the beastkin world, Toby (a rabbit whose impending marriage was called off) is forced into an arranged marriage with Enzo (the Wolf King and adoptive father of his former fiancée) following an unexpected one-night stand. Humiliated again and again by his ex and her family, Toby is saved by Enzo through crisis after crisis, and what begins as forced dependence slowly turns into helpless devotion — sparking a dangerous, forbidden romance defined by an extreme emotional tension.
在兽人世界中，兔子 Toby 原本的婚约被突然取消，却在一次意外的一夜情后，被迫与 Enzo（狼王，也是他前未婚妻的养父）结下政治联姻。一次又一次被前未婚妻和她的家族羞辱践踏，Toby 却总在危机中被 Enzo 一次次救下。本是被迫依附，却渐渐在无力抗拒中沦陷成卑微又深切的爱恋——一段情绪张力拉满的禁忌危险爱恋由此展开。
